b: I am a 76-year-old Korean grandmother. I started my Blogspot blog in August. I don't have any special expertise or unique content, but I have lived a long life, so I simply write about Korean history, culture, traditions, food, travel, and everyday life.

Anyway, I have published 38 posts, but so far only 20 of them have been indexed by Google.
It's frustrating, but people say this is normal, so I'm trying to accept it and be patient.
